title: SQL FCI health: quorum + shared disk + iSCSI + operator auth
description: The nexus-cli health verb for the SQL Server FCI: WSFC quorum, the clustered Physical Disk, iSCSI sessions on both FCI nodes, and the operator-auth round-trip.

observe.what: wsfc-quorum 4/4 NodeMajority + SQL-role Online + 1 clustered Physical Disk Online + an iSCSI session on each FCI node + the FCI answering as nexus-cluster-admin

whatProves: the FCI is healthy end-to-end: WSFC quorum, the shared iSCSI LUN as a clustered Physical Disk, and the operator SQL login authenticating against the FCI virtual server.
